summary: Add twelve published REDSOX channel/layer/cruise thickness records, preserving all 701 frozen references, every prior record and CSV cell. The new reference inventory reconstructs 713 references in memory without rewriting the near-cap base.

source_document_provenance.original_page_visually_reviewed: PDF page 9 / printed 577, Table 2 and Section 5a

scientific_review: The twelve references represent three layer components (bottom, interfacial, whole plume), two channels and two cruises. Each retains the source-reported mean, sampled minimum/maximum and CTD/LADCP cast count. They are source facts from the original published table, not twelve new independent observations. Exact source-fact pointers, hash, DOI, locator and PDF provenance are retained.

Thickness is a vertical distance, distinct from sea-surface-referenced core depth, equilibration depth, water depth or upper/lower boundary coordinates. Keep the existing reported_vertical_thickness metric with explicit source statistic and sampled extrema. No upper/lower boundaries or uniform physical current thickness are inferred. Individual mean weights and per-cast geometry are not reconstructed.

Source bottom-layer top is the velocity maximum. The plume top uses any of speed below cutoff, direction departure greater than45degrees, or salinity below cutoff. Winter REDSOX-1 uses0.075m/s and36.5psu; summer REDSOX-2 uses0.05m/s and35.7psu. Source campaign labels do not establish matched seasonal means, common-operator comparisons, confidence bounds or annual extrema.

Statistics are conditional on significant active plume flow; inactive casts were omitted. Layer records share casts and their counts/extrema must not be summed. Bottom layers below approximately15m were undetectable with the source LADCP observations. Quiescence is not zero-thickness evidence. Channel dimensions are bathymetry, not matched plume width; no stored-volume multiplication.

The pinned reference inventory retains base JSON/CSV exact byte hashes and adds small immutable JSON/CSV pieces. Cloud loader tests preserve all701prior references, all other current records, source contexts, ownership and every old CSV cell/order, while appending12RedSea references. JSON/CSV content reconciliation rejects repinned wrong cells, duplicates, unknown owners, overwritten contexts, source-rule/selection mutations, false physical/annual/volume claims and bad counts/hashes/schema.

Thirteen cloud tests and six exact-code baseline checks passed. No new raw fields, source numerical reconstruction or local numerical tests. All validation runs sequentially on one idle cloud CPU; local work is source text/figure review, code, metadata, hashes and exact artifact retention. The original private PDF remains ignored and unredistributed.

Coverage is713scoped references for101/111direct owners, not complete current depths. Separate model inventoryv48 remains96/111regional support/302supported27unresolved, with no physical full-route profiles or stored volume.
